title: Resolutive Science: Post-Falsification Diagnostic Release
description: Resolutive Science v0.4.0 is a post-falsification diagnostic release for the frozen one-parameter RCMS cosmological screening surrogate. Protocols 17–20 test residual topology, radial/transverse parameter consistency, redshift locality with look-elsewhere calibration, and exact-redshift cross-survey concordance between DESI DR2 and BOSS DR12. The diagnostic block finds diffuse post-fit residual structure, a DESI-specific channel tension, no calibrated redshift-locality evidence, and exact-z survey discordance at z=0.51. The preregistered gate DIAGNOSTIC_STOP_NO_EXTENSION is activated; no new cosmological RCMS functional form is generated from these residuals. The release does not claim discovery of new physics or experimental validation of Resolutive Physics.
